content.title: Purdue vs. Arizona: Predictions, How to Watch for Free (3/28/26)
content.text: No. 2 Purdue (30–8) faces No. 1 Arizona (35–2) today in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight at SAP Center in San Jose, California. The Wildcats enter the Elite Eight for the first time since 2015 after a dominant 109–88 win over Arkansas on Thursday in the Sweet 16. Brayden Burries led with 23 points and Koa Peat was right behind with 21, as the Wildcats shot over 60% from the field, showcasing why they might just be the team to beat in this tournament. Six Arizona players scored 14 points or more. The Wildcats topped 100 points without high-volume shooting from deep, making just eight attempts from beyond the arc. They dominated the paint, where they scored 60 points and got to the foul line often, where they added another 30. Purdue, meanwhile, edged out Texas in a 79–77 thriller on Thursday. Trey Kaufman-Renn delivered the game-winning tip-in with under a second remaining, finishing with 20 points and eight rebounds as the Boilermakers survived a tightly contested battle. The Purdue backcourt of Braden Smith and Fletcher Loyer combined for 34 points, with Loyer draining all four of the Boilermakers’ three-pointers. Prediction While Purdue’s experience and half-court execution keep it competitive, Arizona’s pace, scoring depth, and elite efficiency give the Wildcats the edge. Predicted Final Score: Arizona 84, Purdue 79 Tip-off for today’s game between Purdue and Arizona is set for 8:49 PM Eastern / 5:49 PM Pacific at SAP Center in San Jose, California. The game airs on TBS and streams live on the TBS app and website, as well as HBO Max. If you’re a cord-cutter without an active livestreaming plan, you can watch the game for free by taking advantage of free trials from DIRECTV STREAM, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV. Hulu + Live TV also includes Disney+ and ESPN Select as part of its standard plan.
